A complete budget requires enacting all regular appropriations bills prior to this deadline

According to Congressional Research Service data and analysis by the Pew Research Center, Congress has passed all required regular appropriations measures before October 1 only four times since 1977: for fiscal years 1977, 1989, 1995, and 1997
Since Fiscal Year 1997, Congress has consistently relied on continuing resolutions or passed full-year appropriations packages after the start of the fiscal year.

claim_traces.claim_title: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood
claim_traces.claim_text: "Octopuses have three hearts and their blood is blue."
reasoning_steps: Octopuses possess three hearts and blue blood
Two branchial hearts pump blood through the gills, while a third systemic heart pumps oxygenated blood to the rest of the body
Their blood is blue because it uses a copper-rich protein called hemocyanin to bind and transport oxygen, rather than the iron-based hemoglobin found in vertebrates
When oxygenated, hemocyanin turns a distinct blue color.

For instance, the Empire State Building in New York City is struck by lightning an average of 20 to 25 times each year.
